cases.name: brush-suite:extended_tests:35
cases.script:
[[ "x" =~ (a| *) ]]   && echo "1. Matched"
[[ "a b" =~ ^(a |b) ]] && echo "2. Matched: [${BASH_REMATCH[0]}]"
[[ "a b" =~ ^(a |b)$ ]] || echo "3. No match"
[[ " " =~ ^( )$ ]]    && echo "4. Matched: [${BASH_REMATCH[1]}]"

cases.name: brush-suite:extended_tests:70
cases.script:
s=$'a\nb'
[[ $s =~ ^b ]] && echo "wrong 1" || echo "ok 1"
[[ $s =~ a$ ]] && echo "wrong 2" || echo "ok 2"
[[ $s =~ ^a.b$ ]] && echo "ok 3"
t=$' \t\nabc \t\n'
re=$'[ \t\n]+$'
[[ $t =~ $re ]] && printf '[%s]\n' "${t::${#t}-${#BASH_REMATCH}}"

cases.name: bashkit-suite:bashbox-interpreter-core:871
cases.script: re='('; [[ a =~ $re ]]; echo $?; re='[[:foo:]]'; [[ a =~ $re ]]; echo $?; [[ abc =~ b(c) ]]; echo $? ${BASH_REMATCH[@]}

cases.name: bashkit-suite:control-flow:444
cases.script:
x="error: line 42"
if [[ "$x" =~ error:\ line\ ([0-9]+) ]]; then
  echo "line ${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
else
  echo "no match"
fi

cases.name: global nameref target
cases.script:
other=(old spare); declare -n BASH_REMATCH=other; [[ abc =~ (b) ]]; printf 's=%s n=%s
' "$?" "${#BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; printf '<%s>
' "${other[@]}"; BASH_REMATCH=tail; printf '<%s>
' "${other[@]}"

cases.name: circular nameref fallback
cases.script:
declare -n BASH_REMATCH=other other=BASH_REMATCH; [[ abc =~ (b) ]]; printf 's=%s
' "$?"; printf '<%s>
' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; BASH_REMATCH=tail; printf '<%s>
' "${other[@]}"

cases.name: deep nameref fallback
cases.script:
declare -n BASH_REMATCH=a a=b b=c c=d d=e e=f f=g g=h h=i i=j; [[ abc =~ (b) ]]; printf 's=%s
' "$?"; printf '<%s>
' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; printf 'j=%s
' "${j-unset}"

cases.name: OPTIND target preserves cursor
cases.script:
set -- -a -b; getopts ab opt; printf 'before:%s,%s
' "$opt" "$OPTIND"; declare -n BASH_REMATCH=OPTIND; [[ z0 =~ ([0-9]+) ]]; printf 'match:%s,%s
' "$?" "$OPTIND"; getopts ab opt; printf 'next:%s,%s,%s
' "$?" "$opt" "$OPTIND"

cases.name: prefix function restoration
cases.script: BASH_REMATCH=(global); f(){ [[ abc =~ (b) ]]; printf '<%s>\n' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; }; BASH_REMATCH=prefix f; printf '<%s>\n' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"

cases.name: scalar-local-restoration
cases.script:
BASH_REMATCH=(global spare); f(){ local BASH_REMATCH=local; [[ abc123 =~ ([0-9]+) ]]; printf 'inside=%s
' "$?"; printf '<%s>
' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; }; f; printf '<%s>
' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"

cases.name: scalar-local-no-match-restoration
cases.script: BASH_REMATCH=(global spare); f(){ local BASH_REMATCH=local; [[ abc =~ (z) ]]; printf 'inside=%s n=%s\n' "$?" "${#BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; }; f; printf '<%s>\n' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"

cases.name: scalar-local-nameref-restoration
cases.script: BASH_REMATCH=(global spare); other=old; f(){ local -n BASH_REMATCH=other; [[ abc =~ (b) ]]; printf '<%s>\n' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; }; f; printf '<%s>\n' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}" "${other[@]}"

cases.name: readonly resolved array target preserves predicate
cases.script:
other=(old spare); readonly other; declare -n BASH_REMATCH=other; [[ abc =~ (b) ]]; printf 'match=%s
' "$?"; [[ abc =~ z ]]; printf 'miss=%s
' "$?"; printf '<%s>
' "${other[@]}"

cases.name: readonly scalar origin preserves predicate
cases.script: BASH_REMATCH=old; readonly BASH_REMATCH; [[ abc =~ (b) ]]; printf 'match=%s v=%s\n' "$?" "$BASH_REMATCH"; [[ abc =~ z ]]; printf 'miss=%s v=%s\n' "$?" "$BASH_REMATCH"
